# `aitbc trade sync-status`

Get the inter-chain trading sync status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade sync-status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade sync-status
```
